hero.title: Traditional Thai Massage at Peony
hero.text: A quiet retreat where traditional Thai technique meets warm oils, herbal compresses and unhurried attention — so your body and mind can settle again.

about.text: Peony is a small Thai spa built around one idea — that real rest cannot be rushed. Our therapists are trained in traditional Thai technique and work with warm oils, herbal compresses and steady pressure, in rooms kept deliberately quiet.

services.title: Chosen for how you feel today
services.text: Every treatment begins with a short conversation, so the pressure, oils and pace are matched to you rather than to a menu.

thai.name: Traditional Thai Massage

aroma.name: Aromatherapy Massage

herbal.name: Herbal Compress

items.q: Do I need to book in advance?
items.a: We recommend it, especially in the evenings and at weekends. Walk-ins are welcome whenever a therapist is free, but booking guarantees the room and the time you want.
For traditional Thai massage we provide loose cotton clothing you change into. For oil treatments you undress to your comfort level and are covered with towels throughout.
Ten minutes before your appointment is plenty. It gives you time to change, have a cup of tea, and tell your therapist what your body needs today.

items.q: Is it suitable for a first-time guest?
items.a: Very much so. Tell us it is your first visit and your therapist will start gently, explain each stage and adjust the pressure as you go. Nothing should ever hurt.
Always. Light, medium or firm — and you can change your mind halfway through. Just say the word; your therapist would far rather adjust than have you endure.
Let us know at least a few hours ahead and there is no charge at all. Life happens; we would simply rather offer the slot to someone else than leave the room empty.
